verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Abacum connects CRM and HRIS data alongside ERP into one governed source of truth. They also say it plans headcount in the same connected model as the budget and joins pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model, which covers the core of the story. Payroll connectors are never named, CRM connector depth is only a one-line claim, and nothing hands-on confirms the data actually lands in the same model as the books. missing for 10: explicit payroll connector evidence, named CRM/HRIS connectors and how they sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, payroll/HRIS and CRM connectors bring headcount and pipeline data into the same model as the books

citations.quote: It connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet, and warehouse data into one governed source of truth
Understand and plan for each new hire by connecting your HRIS with Abacum
Plan, approve and forecast headcount in the same connected model as your budget
Abacum connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model.
